text: As long-time residents, my family and I are proud to call Mission Viejo home. I’m honored to serve on the City Council and seek re-election.
Throughout my term, I've used my business and MBA background to put residents first by protecting taxpayer dollars, improving transparency, and making thoughtful decisions.

I put our community first by:
Supporting improvements to Sierra Recreation Center and Napoli Park
Working to keep taxpayer dollars from subsidizing private organizations
Advocating for thorough research before approving multimillion-dollar projects
Sponsoring a much-needed refuge lane at Marguerite/Sierra Expanding community events without taxpayer dollars Providing residents with better access to information about City decisions
Encouraging safety and traffic improvements from Oso to Avery Parkways

When re-elected, I'll continue to:
Require thorough review before major projects move forward
Protect tax dollars through diligent oversight, ensuring wise spending
Keep Oso Creek Golf Course self-sustaining
Support seniors, working families and individuals, local businesses, and public safety
Advocate for our City Library

Mission Viejo deserves transparent, accountable leadership focused on residents. I will continue working to keep Mission Viejo safe, financially responsible, and thriving. Let’s move forward together. Re-Elect Cynthia Vasquez to District 3!

text: Retired City of Mission Viejo Supervisor
Mission Viejo has been my home since I was 8 years old. As a single parent, I raised three children here, who graduated from our public schools in Mission Viejo, just like I did.
As a supervisor, I delivered for Mission Viejo:

Remodeled Matt Davis Park, Crucero Park, Vista del Lago Park, M.M. O’Neil Park, Pavion Park
Worked with Orange County Fire Authority on fire retardant material, weed abatement, and brush removal
Regularly coordinated after hours emergency response efforts with Orange County Sheriff’s Department, Orange County Fire Authority, and water districts
Ensured balanced multimillion dollar budgets
Helped plan/coordinate Mission Viejo’s Veterans Day, Memorial Day, and 4th of July events, along with Pacific Symphony on the Village Green
Worked with Julie Foudy Soccer Camp, public schools, and over 300 Eagle Scouts on sports fields, parks, and open spaces
I’m passionate about my hometown of Mission Viejo. I’m active in the Mission Viejo Elks Club. I served on the Viejo Little League Board. I was named City of Mission Viejo Employee of the Year.

If you elect me as your Councilmember, I will:
Ensure strong funding for our public safety
Strengthen wildfire preparedness
Fund school resource officers and crossing guards
Help small businesses by reducing bureaucratic red tape
Enhance parks, trails, and open spaces

I’ve earned endorsements for Council from:
Mission Viejo Mayor Wendy Bucknum and Councilmembers Brian
Goodell, Trish Kelley, Bob Ruesch
Former Mission Viejo Mayors Robert Breton, Dave Leckness
Please vote Bryan Zahn for City Council. zahnforcitycouncil.com
